item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently ends United States participation in the JCPOA; the consequence occurs in this segment, with subsequent agency steps implementing that decision.","evidence":"I am today making good on my pledge to end the participation of the United States in the JCPOA."},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President states a national-interest conclusion and establishes policy objectives, while leaving the means of pursuing them adjustable rather than itself reimposing sanctions.","evidence":"The United States will continue to pursue these aims and the objectives contained in the Iran strategy"},{"segment_id":"3","code":2,"rationale":"The Secretaries are mandatorily directed to produce later consequential outcomes—ending participation and reimposing all covered sanctions—within a specified period.","evidence":"The Secretary of State and the Secretary of the Treasury shall immediately begin taking steps to re-impose all United States sanctions lifted or waived in connection with the JCPOA"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretaries must coordinate and prepare possible executive, regulatory, waiver, listing, and guidance measures, but the segment preserves discretion and does not dictate those later legal results.","evidence":"The Secretary of State and the Secretary of the Treasury shall coordinate, as appropriate, on steps needed to achieve this aim."},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"Defense and other agency heads are directed to undertake contingency preparation, an internal operational and planning function without a specified legal consequence.","evidence":"shall prepare to meet, swiftly and decisively, all possible modes of Iranian aggression"},{"segment_id":"6","code":1,"rationale":"The Department of Defense must develop and retain national-security capabilities; this is internal operational direction rather than a present or dictated later legal consequence.","evidence":"shall ensure that the United States develops and retains the means"},{"segment_id":"7","code":1,"rationale":"Agencies must conduct monitoring and advisory work, while the remaining language preserves existing executive authorities and functions; these are internal management provisions.","evidence":"the heads of agencies shall advise me, as appropriate, regarding opportunities for such consultations"}]}
